clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 美联储该加息就加息？摩根大通策略师：别拖了
title_lines: 摩根大通策略师喊话美联储
加息宜早不宜迟 别拖了
市场缺指引 长端利率压力大

subtitles.en: What markets are worried about, what's the reaction function of the Fed?
subtitles.zh: 市场担心什么？美联储的反应机制如何？

subtitles.en: Market doesn't really love the fact that we don't have forward guidance.
subtitles.zh: 市场不喜欢缺乏前瞻指引。

subtitles.en: And what's interesting, I said, I was off last week, you saw, you got a rally in twos and a continued sell-off in the 30-year, on software data, we had software CPI data, we had
subtitles.zh: 有趣的是，上周我休假时，两年期国债上涨，而30年期持续下跌，还有软件CPI数据。

subtitles.en: a software employment number, and, you know, I don't think it matters what the Fed does.
subtitles.zh: 还有软件就业数据，我认为美联储做什么并不重要。

subtitles.en: You know, we've had a view that the Fed's on hold, you know what, at this point I'm like, go ahead, just hike and move on with it, because you've got this, the long end backing up,
subtitles.zh: 我们一直认为美联储按兵不动，但现在我觉得，干脆加息吧，因为长端利率在上升。

subtitles.en: and they're almost trying to bully him into hiding it. How much influence do you think they have over the long end?
subtitles.zh: 他们几乎在逼他加息。你认为他们对长端利率有多大影响？

subtitles.en: Well, I think that's exactly the problem, is that the markets are worrying in the absence of forward guidance, in the absence of clarity of what the Fed will do with inflation, and
subtitles.zh: 这正是问题所在：市场在缺乏前瞻指引和通胀政策清晰度的情况下担忧。

subtitles.en: the concerns about how the Fed's going to define inflation, you know, you get a rally in twos and think, okay, maybe the market's not going to, maybe we're not going to get a hike next month,
subtitles.zh: 关于美联储如何定义通胀的担忧，两年期上涨让人以为下月不会加息，但长端因担忧而上升。

subtitles.en: but the long end comes up, because of concerns about that.
subtitles.zh: 长端上升正是出于这些担忧。

subtitles.en: And I think that, Warsh has it in his power, it'll be interesting this week, tomorrow, we'll have the Fed minutes, we'll be able to see, okay, the three dissenters, well, of the nine people
subtitles.zh: 我认为沃什有能力，本周美联储会议纪要将显示三位反对者的情况。

subtitles.en: who thought that rates will be higher this year, that they should hike sometime this year, what is the composition of that?
subtitles.zh: 那些认为今年利率会更高、应该在今年某个时候加息的人，他们的构成是怎样的？

subtitles.en: Are those Fed presidents that are coming on to the committee FOMC as voting members next year?
subtitles.zh: 这些人是明年加入FOMC并成为投票委员的联储主席吗？

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
